summary: Validated the v2.0.1 fix for the Companion 5.x setVariableDefinitions API-shape bug in companion-module-tenveo-ptz. Ran `npm test` (17 suites, 524 assertions all passing), verified the new regression-guard test, and inspected the built tarball tenveo-ptz-2.0.1.tgz. All checks pass.

checks: getVariables() is a plain object, NOT an array (matches Companion 5.x Array.isArray rejection)
All 31 required variable IDs present with {name: string} shape

critical_code_review_comments: Fix is minimal, correct and targeted: src/variables.js now returns an object literal matching @companion-module/base 2.x contract.
Regression-guard test reproduces the exact Array.isArray() check from Companion 5.x — good long-term protection.
Bundled main.js in the built tarball contains no `setVariableDefinitions([...])` array-call pattern; object-literal keys are present.
Physical install on real Companion 5.0.4 + Stream Deck cannot be automated here — user must confirm CAM01 instance init succeeds after installing 2.0.1.
context_for_next_testing_agent: This is a Node.js Bitfocus Companion module (no web server, no REST API, no frontend). Testing is limited to `npm test` at /app/companion-module-tenveo-ptz and inspection of the built .tgz. Ignore the /app/backend and /app/frontend supervisor services — they are unrelated to this module.
